Join Northbridge’s Global Growth Journey 

Our purpose at Northbridge is ‘Protect what matters most’ and we live it every day, whether that’s protecting the world’s highest security environments or agricultural businesses, we care deeply about our people, their families, and our wider communities.   

Northbridge Security is on a mission to unlock more value for our customers through the power of our people and solutions - and right now is a pivotal moment in our evolution. We’re scaling with intent, driving an incredible growth trajectory with innovation and customer impact at the heart of everything we do. With operations across New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, the USA, Canada, and Europe and exports to over 140 countries, we’re offering roles that shape our global mission, while being based right here in New Zealand.

As we expand our Hamilton-based teams, this is your chance to be part of a true Kiwi tech success story making a global impact. If you’re driven by passion and purpose to protect what matters most, come help shape the future of what’s possible with us. 

The Opportunity

We’re looking for curious, customer-focused people to join our Support Services team as Technical Support Engineers. Based in Hamilton, this role is all about helping customers and channel partners get the best from Northbridge Security products, working from our contact centre environment to troubleshoot technical queries and deliver timely, accurate solutions.

The team operates on a shift rotation covering mornings and afternoons between 7:00am and 11:30pm, with one Saturday shift every few months and an additional on-call allowance available where required.

What you’ll be doing:

Acting as the first point of contact for technical queries from customers and channel partners, investigating, diagnosing, and troubleshooting technical issues.

Delivering timely resolutions via phone and email while accurately capturing notes in our CRM

Providing an exceptional support experience that builds customer and channel partner confidence

Collaborating with regional and global teams to resolve issues effectively

Contributing to our knowledge base to support both our team and our customers

Applying root cause analysis techniques and following escalation pathways when required

Continuously building your product knowledge and technical skills through ongoing learning

The Fit

You don’t need to have it all figured out yet, what matters most is your ambition, curiosity, and commitment to building a career in technical support. Whether you’re already on the path toward a Technical Advisor role or you’re a junior looking for the right place to grow, we’re looking for people who are eager to learn, enjoy solving problems, are passionate about helping others and are committed to creating positive customer experiences while developing their technical expertise.

What you’ll bring to the team:

Experience in a helpdesk, customer support, technical support, or service-focused environment — or a strong interest in starting your career in this space

A foundation in IT, networking, device troubleshooting, or a willingness to build these skills through training and hands-on learning

Familiarity with Access Control Systems and electronics (an advantage but not essential).

A naturally curious mindset with a desire to learn new technologies and continuously develop your technical knowledge

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

The ability to explain technical concepts clearly and tailor communication to different audiences

The ability to stay calm under pressure with strong attention to detail

A collaborative approach and a commitment to continuous improvement

A genuine interest in growing toward more advanced technical support or Technical Advisor responsibilities over time

Why Northbridge?

At Northbridge, we create a supportive, family-friendly environment where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement drive everything we do. We value work-life balance and prioritise the well-being of our people, offering:

We work hybrid with three set team days in the office each week, and the remaining days you can work from home or the office, whichever you prefer

Free parking, a subsidised on-site café, and great local eateries when you're in the office

KiwiSaver contributions and annual bonuses

Fun team-building events, inspiring guest speakers, and regular team lunches

If you're a problem solver with a passion for customer support and tech, and you’re keen to grow your career with a global leader—we’d love to hear from you. Applications will be reviewed as they’re received, and the role may be filled before the listing closes, so don’t wait—apply now!
